Definition: an assessment (as based upon a census)
BiblicalUsage: Mekes is the assessment, the tribute levied as a share of the spoil. Numbers 31:28 orders a tribute unto the LORD from the men of war, one soul of five hundred, and Numbers 31:37 counts the LORD's tribute of the sheep at six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the tribute teaches that even the spoils of victory belong to God first, not to the men who won them.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
